summary: Iteration 75 - Financial Features Testing. All 25 backend tests passed (100%). Tested: campus accounts with starting balance, inter-account transfers, budgeting per sub-location/department, admin-editable categories, asset appreciation/depreciation, and product variants with auto-barcodes.
critical_code_review_comments: Campus accounts auto-create from sub-locations + savings account when first accessed
Transfers correctly create expense on source and donation on destination with transfer_id linking
Budgets support campus_id, location_id, department, and period filtering
Categories auto-seed 14 defaults (6 income + 7 expense + 1 both) if collection is empty
Asset valuation supports both appreciation (default) and depreciation methods
Product variants auto-generate barcodes with format: {country_code}-{product_id_last6}-V{num}
Variant array initialized with $set if null before $push (prevents null array issues)
seed_data_creation: Tests create and cleanup TEST_ prefixed data automatically
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 75 tested financial improvements: (1) Campus accounts at /api/financial/campus-accounts/{campus_id} auto-create operational accounts for each sub-location + savings account. PUT updates starting_balance, name, currency. (2) Transfers at /api/financial/transfers create expense+donation pair with transfer_id linking. (3) Budgets at /api/financial/budgets support campus_id, location_id, department, period filtering. (4) Categories at /api/financial/categories auto-seed 14 defaults. Admin can POST new and DELETE existing. (5) Asset valuation at PUT /api/financial/assets/{id}/valuation supports appreciation (default) or depreciation method. (6) Product variants at /api/products/{id}/variants with auto-barcode generation. PUT updates, DELETE removes. POST /api/products/{id}/generate-barcodes generates missing barcodes.

campus_accounts_get.notes: Auto-creates accounts from sub-locations + savings if none exist

campus_accounts_update.notes: Updates name, starting_balance, currency, type, notes

transfers_create.notes: Creates expense on source + donation on destination with transfer_id

transfers_list.notes: Lists all transfers, supports campus_id filter

budgets_list.notes: Lists budgets with campus_id and period filters

categories_get.notes: Returns categories, auto-seeds 14 defaults if empty

categories_create.notes: Admin creates new category with name and type

asset_valuation.notes: Updates current_value with appreciation (default) or depreciation method

product_variants_update.notes: Updates variant price, stock, barcode, etc.

product_variants_delete.notes: Removes variant, sets has_variants=false if no variants remain

generate_barcodes.notes: Auto-generates barcodes for variants without one

product_variants_only.notes: Product with has_variants=true and price=0 works correctly
